Endowment.Description: Amount of money available to divide on the trial.

Endowment_pmod.Description: Cue regressor weight, calculated by subtracting the mean endowment for that run and game/role code from the trial endowment and rounding the difference.

Decision.Description: Endowment minus the amount associated with the selected option on decision rows. The conversion code assigns zero for a rejected offer.

Decision_pmod.Description: Decision regressor weight derived from the monetary option as a fraction of the endowment, centered using the run's reference mean for that decision regressor. On recipient option-presented and choice rows the converter uses the offered fraction even when the offer is rejected.
